Actress Aakanksha Chamoa Discusses Post-Divorce Plans

Actress Aakanksha Chamoa has stated she does not wish to remarry following her divorce from Gaurav Khanna. She indicated her future plans include purchasing her own home. The actress shared these thoughts in relation to her post-divorce life.
